title: The two decisions that stay with a person

record.surface: the page, full width if you can, with Your decisions in shot
actions: press Request roadside assistance first. It is the requirement beat 05 put on screen, the one the rule pack answers with a human action instead of a field, and get_assistance_options reads it out without being able to close it
then press File this claim with the pointer, slowly enough to see
unpin nothing, and change no field on the draft
must_show: the Request roadside assistance button being pressed by hand, and the line that replaces it naming the time you pressed it
the roadside collection entry in the requirements list closing once you have pressed it
the File this claim button being pressed by hand
the filed line that appears underneath it
the sentence on the panel saying these buttons are never registered as agent tools
record.note: The order is forced by the product, not by preference. assistanceApplies in src/ui/app.js requires claim.status !== 'filed', so the assistance button closes the moment the claim is filed. Press it first or it cannot be pressed at all. And the panel has to be empty of open requirements before File this claim will do anything: canFile in src/core/filing.js refuses with FILE_REFUSED_REQUIREMENTS while this insurer's derived intake has anything open, which is the defect that gate was written to close. When the car cannot be driven Northwind raises two, the collection address, answered by the location the agent wrote in beat 03, and the roadside collection, answered by the button you press first. If File this claim is still disabled after the press, read the line under it: it names what is open, and the answer is almost always that beat 03 did not write the location.
